events.title: Robo Frenzy — Developer Demo Showcase
events.summary: Watch the Robo Frenzy demo showcase for a look at robot combat, boss creation, and sharing.The free demo is available now on Steam, with local two-player co-op. Download it today and add Robo Frenzy to your wishlist!

events.title: Robo Frenzy joins Steam Next Fest! Play the free demo
events.summary: Hi everyone!Steam Next Fest is here, and we're bringing the robots! The Robo Frenzy demo is free to download and play.Found a robot you like? Capture it, equip it with parts for new attacks and abilities, and give it a custom paint job in Paint Mode. Then share your boss's code with friends or players around the world.
